spots.name: Attu Island
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 224 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L418947.

spots.name: Attu Village
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.
